newsitem.title: USA: Idec buys rights from Pharmacia, Upjohn.
newsitem.headline: Idec buys rights from Pharmacia, Upjohn.

text.p: IDEC Pharmaceuticals Corp said it acquired worldwide rights from Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc to 9-aminocamptothecin (9-AC), an anti-cancer agent.
Under terms of the deal, IDEC will pay $3 million initially plus additional milestone payments. Further financial details were not disclosed.

The deal is subject to approval by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. Pharmacia & Upjohn was required to divest certain rights to 9-AC under a consent decree issued by the FTC due to the merger of Pharmacia and Upjohn in which it was formed.
The drug is currently undergoing Phase II clinical trials.
